notes.title: Version 1.0.3 is now out!
notes.content:
Minigame Party VR was released on April 5 and has been out for one whole week (Hooray!). Some bugs have been discovered over the past week and they are fixed in this patch (there is a list below for specifics). Currently, a local multiplayer mode is being worked on in which players compete against each other in all four minigames in order to get the best combined score (hopefully will be out in the next month or two).

Fixed/Balanced in 1.0.3
[list]
    [*]Basketballs should no longer fall through the hoops without counting as points
    [*]Balls should no longer fly through rings without counting as points
    [*]Basketballs have been made slightly lighter in order to make it easier to reach the top basket
    [*]Lasers are now allowed to collide with eachother
    [*]Targets in Sword Swinger now require less force to break, but they appear a little bit quicker
    [*]Music should now always play whenever a game starts
    [*]Speakers now have collision
[/list]

If you run into any issues/bugs, please either contact me at contact@scornz.com or just send me a tweet @ScornzDev

:D
